---
title: "Member's Usage of Designation"
---

## Permitted Usage {#sec-usage-of-designation}

A certified member may declare themselves certified by the ASA as a:

- **"Certified Data Science Professional (DSP)"** or
- **"Certified Advanced Data Science Professional (AdvDSP)"**

as appropriate according to their certified status.

::: {.callout-important}
The member may **not** state that the designation is an endorsement by the ASA.

If a member's certification lapses or is revoked, the member must **cease usage of the designation within 90 days**.
:::
